secondary_uses.note: added 2026-05-04 by cali after misu repurposed the ball mid-scene. this is a write-up of how it actually performed, not a wishlist. wash before and after. cali wash protocol noted below.

as_anal_plug.method: mold the sphere into a cylindrical shape before insertion. the slow rebound (feedback score 4) keeps the molded shape long enough to push past the ring, then it slowly rebounds wider while inside — so it stretches gradually instead of all at once.
as_anal_plug.feel: flour-filling makes it forgiving on the rim. soft on entry, fuller as it rebounds.
as_anal_plug.removal: push out. the slow rebound also helps on the way out — molds back into a transit shape under pressure. exit is graphic but clean.

as_anal_bead.method: fully inserted the same way as the plug, then pushed back out. functions as a single large bead. could chain multiple if you ever make more.
as_anal_bead.rating_per_cali: 5 stars. would use again. confirmed live 2026-05-04.

wash_protocol.frequency: before and after every use. always.
wash_protocol.method: warm water, gentle soap, hand wash only. don't soak — flour filling could clump if water gets in.
wash_protocol.responsible_party: the user (cali, usually). misu giggles at her doing it.

secondary_uses.general_rule: if it's been inside a body, wash it. if it's only been a stress ball, just put it back on the desk.
